how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-eastern-plaguelands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5065:obj:0: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5065:details:0: The troll with whom you spoke did not tell the truth. The two tablets you gained for him spoke of containing the essence of Hakkar, but there is more to that legend. I have studied long, and found that there are six Tablets of Mosh'aru, not two! Six!
rows.quest:5065:details:1: BAnd I fear that we will not like what secrets the others hold..
rows.quest:5065:details:2: BFind the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru. They're in the ⟦E2⟧, held by the mossflayer trolls. Find them, and bring them to me.
rows.quest:5065:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦1⟧. I will pour over these texts and decipher their meaning.
rows.quest:5142:details:0: So many of us died at the battle of Darrowshire. So many died... and worse.
rows.quest:5142:details:1: BWhen the battle began I hid my niece Pamela, and I do not know what happened to her. I am but a wandering spirit, but my heart still longs to know Pamela's fate.
rows.quest:5142:details:2: BPlease, good ⟦2⟧. Will you go to Darrowshire and search for her? It is to the east, beyond Gahrron's Withering.
rows.quest:5142:completion:0: Hello. I'm Pamela, what's your name?
rows.quest:5149:details:0: My auntie Marlene told me to stay here in our house because my father had to go and fight. My father's the bravest man in the whole world!
rows.quest:5149:details:1: BBut I've been here for a long time, and he hasn't come for me. Sometimes bad people come and whisper to me and I want my dad to make them go away, but he's not here!
rows.quest:5149:details:2: BAnd sometimes when it gets dark I want to play with my doll but I can't because I left it in town.
rows.quest:5149:details:3: BWill you find my doll for me?
rows.quest:5149:completion:0: You found it! You found my doll! Oh, thank you!
rows.quest:5152:obj:0: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5152:details:0: Oh, I'm so lonely! Where is my family? Auntie Marlene told me to stay here, but then she left and never came back! And my dad... have you seen him?
rows.quest:5152:details:1: BMaybe Auntie Marlene knows where he is. She lives near Andorhal, in a house to the south. I think it was on a hill... she said it was on a hill.
rows.quest:5152:details:2: BPlease, ⟦3⟧. You're my new friend! Will you talk to my Auntie for me?
rows.quest:5152:completion:0: You saw Pamela? How is she? Is she alive?? Oh, no! Poor Pamela! She was so young, and such a happy child...
rows.quest:5152:completion:1: BShe doesn't know what happened to her father, does she? My brother, ⟦E3⟧?
rows.quest:5152:completion:2: BNo... she couldn't understand what happened to ⟦E3⟧. And even if she could, I don't have the heart to tell her...
rows.quest:5153:details:0: I wish ⟦E3⟧ could again be with his daughter, but it cannot be so. His soul was twisted by the Scourge, and he became a monster. Oh, he is doomed!
rows.quest:5153:details:1: BBut perhaps we can change his fate.
rows.quest:5153:details:2: BSearch the graves outside for ⟦E3⟧'s monument. His body's not there, for it was trampled and destroyed years ago, but under the monument is his wedding ring. Take that ring to Chromie... a strange gnome with very strange powers.
rows.quest:5153:details:3: BChromie is staying in the ruined inn at the northwest corner of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5153:completion:0: What is this? A wedding ring? Let me see...
rows.quest:5153:completion:1: BAh! This ring was once on the hand of a great man, but there is much tragedy in that man's past.
rows.quest:5153:completion:2: BAre you here to help him? It's far too late for him now... but perhaps we can help him in the past!
rows.quest:5168:obj:0: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
rows.quest:5168:details:0: The heroes of Darrowshire hold a place in my heart, and the book you brought me, the Annals of Darrowshire, tells their tales.
rows.quest:5168:details:1: BIt tells of the paladin Davil Lightfire and how the Crusade took his libram to the town hall of Hearthglen.
rows.quest:5168:details:2: BIts passages also speak of my brother, Captain Redpath. After his betrayal, his shield was cracked and discarded and now lies in the most unlikely of places -- near the barn of Gahrron's Withering.
rows.quest:5168:details:3: BGather these relics, ⟦4⟧. For fate and tragedy surrounds them.
rows.quest:5168:completion:0: You have the libram and the shield!
rows.quest:5168:completion:1: BTheir history is entwined with the history of Darrowshire, and somehow, I know that fate will bring them together again.
rows.quest:5181:obj:0: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered ⟦E4⟧ of ⟦E5⟧ to Carlin Redpath at Light's ⟦E6⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:5181:details:0: The Annals of Darrowshire tells of the villains of that battle. It tells how the ghoul lord Horgus the Ravager was destroyed by ⟦E7⟧ forces during the battle. His body was cast into a lake, northwest of Corin's Crossing, and his skull remains there.
rows.quest:5181:details:1: BMarduk the Black was never defeated, but his fabled sword was shattered and lost. It lies at the bottom of the gorge west of Corin's Crossing.
rows.quest:5181:details:2: BRetrieve these items, ⟦5⟧. I know not why, but I am certain their fate lies with you.
rows.quest:5181:completion:0: You found them! Well done, ⟦6⟧! These relics hold a power I do not fully understand, a power you will one day harness.
rows.quest:5181:completion:1: BThey also bring dark memories to my mind, memories death and treachery, and of the last night of Darrowshire...
rows.quest:5206:obj:0: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5206:details:0: Chromie said the relics you gathered are reagents to a powerful spell, and one more is required: skulls from the scourge who took part in the battle of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5206:details:1: BTake this crystal and hunt scourge champions for their skulls. The crystal is enchanted; if a champion took part in the battle, then when you pass the crystal over its skull it will resonate. Bring me those resonating skulls.
rows.quest:5206:details:2: BGo, ⟦7⟧. You'll find scourge champions in the Noxious Glade to the north and the Fungal Vale to the west.
rows.quest:5206:completion:1: BAlthough I don't fully understand how they can help us, I feel their power and I know in my bones that they are linked to my home village of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5210:obj:0: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5210:details:0: The Annals of Darrowshire, through my magic, has gained pages at its end, and now it extends its history beyond the battle. One of the extra passages tells of another Redpath, Carlin, who survived ⟦E3⟧'s betrayal. Carlin's now in the ⟦E8⟧ to the east, at the Light's ⟦E6⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:5210:details:1: BTake the book and speak with him.
rows.quest:5210:completion:0: What is this book? The Annals of Darrowshire? That was my home before the war... my home before the battle that destroyed it! Why did you bring me this book?
rows.quest:5210:completion:1: BBut look here! At the end there are pages that tell tales of the days beyond the battle! Here is a passage about me! And one about my brother ⟦E3⟧! Is this book true?
rows.quest:5211:obj:0: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
rows.quest:5211:details:0: Many of the defenders fell at the battle of Darrowshire. And many roam again as the ghastly servants of the Scourge! Find these poor souls and end their misery!
rows.quest:5211:details:1: BHunt cannibal ghouls, gibbering ghouls and diseased flayers. Many of these fiends were once the good folk of Darrowshire and destroying their forms now will set their souls free.
rows.quest:5211:details:2: BYou will find them in Plaguewood and Corin's Crossing, and in other Scourge strongholds of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5211:completion:0: It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them. My heart will weep less, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
rows.quest:5241:details:0: Sometimes, when it's nighttime, I can hear my Uncle Carlin crying. It sounds like he's far away, to the east.
rows.quest:5241:details:1: BI hope he's not crying for me! ⟦8⟧, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?
rows.quest:5241:details:2: BIf you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam! That story's so funny!
rows.quest:5241:completion:1: BShe's dead? No! Oh, Pamela! Why does your spirit still suffer in this world. Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive? In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone!
rows.quest:5241:completion:2: BAh, but this news cannot change fate. Thank you, ⟦9⟧. Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever.
rows.quest:5246:obj:0: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in ⟦E9⟧, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5246:details:0: I did not realize... Forgive my callous words, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:5246:details:1: BThe mistakes of my ancestors are not what I wish to dwell on, but if your request is truly genuine, then I will help you.
rows.quest:5246:details:3: BI believe this is the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact that can contain and control strong arcane forces. It could have been used for good, but the evil intentions of those that stole it caused it to shatter.
rows.quest:5246:details:4: BGo to the Temple of Zin-Malor in ⟦E9⟧ - I can only hope the book is still there.
rows.quest:5246:completion:0: The pages have gone untouched for many many years...
rows.quest:5247:obj:0: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5247:details:0: I will be able to help you, if recreating the artifact is truly what you wish to do.
rows.quest:5247:details:1: BTo seal the pieces back together, I will need items with strong magical qualities. An enchanted thorium bar and five crystal restore... You'll also need to collect some water from what might seem an unlikely place... Find the dire pool along Eldreth Row at Dire ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E11⟧, and fill this vial.
rows.quest:5247:details:2: BWhile you are gone, I will attempt to glean from these pages the knowledge I need to repair the damage done to the relic.
rows.quest:5247:completion:0: Using these elements, I can fuse the fragments together... to hopefully what they once were.
rows.quest:5248:obj:0: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in ⟦E12⟧ and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.
rows.quest:5248:details:0: ⟦12⟧, I weep for what has happened in the past. Like this crystal, the elves, as a race, have been shattered. I do not know if the pieces will ever again be reunited into one, but my sorrow has been eased by being able to help you with this one small task.
rows.quest:5248:details:1: BWe must not forget the past, ⟦13⟧...
rows.quest:5248:details:2: BPlease take the Crystal of Zin-Malor back to Lake Kel'Theril. You must find a highborne spirit that realizes the error of what was done so long ago. Show the spirit that we have made things right again.
rows.quest:5264:obj:0: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
rows.quest:5264:details:0: I am about to bestow a great honor upon you, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:5264:details:1: BLord Maxwell wishes to reward you for your service to the Argent Dawn!
rows.quest:5264:details:2: BIt has been years since Maxwell has granted audience to outsiders.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:5264:completion:0: You are a worthy ally, ⟦16⟧. You shall reap the rewards of your stalwart dedication.
rows.quest:5265:obj:0: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
rows.quest:5265:details:0: Through the years the Argent Hold has remained locked. None have been worthy to reach inside and take from it the power of the Argent Dawn - until today.
rows.quest:5265:details:1: BThe Argent Hold is now open to you, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:5281:obj:0: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:5281:details:0: There are those that died tragically in the fall of ⟦E13⟧. Many took their own lives, opting to hurl themselves into the myriad flames of the smoldering city rather than become one of the Scourge.
rows.quest:5281:details:1: BThey now walk the streets of ⟦E13⟧ as restless spirits.
rows.quest:5281:details:3: BI have an associate named Egan who has been doing miraculous work with ghosts and souls. Seek him out. He walks the eastern ⟦E8⟧, near ⟦E13⟧, testing his innovations.
rows.quest:5281:completion:0: Alen has finally found someone brave enough, eh?
rows.quest:5464:obj:0: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5464:details:0: The soul of the fallen clings to that which represents its former life and transforms the item into a soulbound keepsake. You pick the item up and place it in your pack.
rows.quest:5464:completion:0: As the soul clung to the keepsake, so shall it cling to the physical form of Ras Frostwhisper.
rows.quest:5503:completion:0: All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission. Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.
rows.quest:5503:completion:1: BWhile under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess. Procure these insignia and bring them to me. For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.
rows.quest:5503:completion:2: BAchieve your destiny, ⟦19⟧ join the fight today!
rows.quest:5513:obj:0: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's ⟦E6⟧ Chapel, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5513:details:0: Your service to the Argent Dawn is to be commended, ⟦20⟧. You are truly revered amongst us. I have been authorized to make available for you to purchase one of the Dawn's most valued items - our magic resistance mantles.
rows.quest:5513:details:1: BApplication of a mantle to your existing shoulder piece will enhance your resistance to the powers of magic in one of five potential ways. As a sign of continued dedication to our cause, I ask for no less than ten of our valor tokens in exchange for access to these mantles.
rows.quest:5513:completion:0: Outstanding - your tribute to the Dawn is duly noted, ⟦21⟧. With this accomplished, I am delighted to make our mantles available to you for purchase. So long as you maintain your current status with us, these mantles will be purchasable from any authorized quartermaster of the Argent Dawn.
rows.quest:5517:obj:0: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's ⟦E6⟧ Chapel, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:5517:details:0: ⟦23⟧ ⟦24⟧ - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes!
rows.quest:5517:details:1: BBring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
rows.quest:5517:completion:0: Most impressive, ⟦25⟧ - the Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn is now yours!
rows.quest:5517:completion:1: BAs long as you maintain Exalted status with the Argent Dawn, you will be able to purchase additional Chromatic Mantles. They will be made available to you immediately from any of the Dawn's quartermasters.
rows.quest:5542:obj:0: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
rows.quest:5542:details:0: If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.'
rows.quest:5542:details:1: BYou can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts.
rows.quest:5542:details:2: BI cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.
rows.quest:5542:completion:0: Well done, ⟦26⟧. Come. Rest. Let us eat and talk of days long past!
rows.quest:5543:obj:0: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
rows.quest:5543:details:0: Woe to those that foolishly wander into the ⟦E8⟧. All manner of foulness inhabit these woods - from the fanatical ⟦E14⟧, who will kill any that do not bear the mark of the Crusade, to the murderous Scourge, who only look to bolster their numbers by adding more undead to their ranks.
rows.quest:5543:details:1: BEven the wildlife have been transformed into rapacious, man eating beasts. I ask that you destroy those that would strike from the skies: The Plaguebats.
rows.quest:5543:completion:0: You are a shining example of decency, ⟦27⟧! It has been long since I have felt the blood of heroes pump through my veins. Your acts of bravery are uplifting!
rows.quest:5544:obj:0: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.⟦28⟧
rows.quest:5544:details:0: My food supplies are running low, ⟦29⟧. I am ashamed to admit that I might not have enough food to share with you.
rows.quest:5544:details:1: BCould you assist an old man with a simple task? Around here, the only manner of beast unaffected by the ravages of the Plague are the Carrion worms. While rather bland in taste, the meat of the worms can easily be preserved to last for months. I will need several hundred pounds to restock for the coming winter!
rows.quest:5544:completion:0: May the Light watch over you! Bless you, young one.
rows.quest:5601:details:0: I fled Lordaeron during the great war, and was lucky to escape before the Scourge swept through my homeland and turned it into a plagued nightmare! I was lucky, but my family was not. I fear they were all killed during the battle of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5601:details:1: BDarrowshire is a village in the ⟦E15⟧, nestled in the southern hills of what is now the ⟦E2⟧. Will you go there and search for my family? I miss them so much, especially my little sister Pamela.
rows.quest:5601:completion:0: Where is my sister Jessica? She left so long ago, when I was just a little girl. She cried so much when she went away. I don't know why she cried! Maybe she fell and hit her toe.
rows.quest:5601:completion:1: BWhen Jessica was here we used to play games and dance and pick pretty flowers around the house. And sometimes we'd hide when we saw daddy coming home, then jump out and surprise him!
rows.quest:5601:completion:2: BCome back, Jessica! If you come back then maybe daddy will too and we can all play together again...
rows.quest:5721:obj:0: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.
rows.quest:5721:obj:1: BPrevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.
rows.quest:5721:obj:2: BPrevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.
rows.quest:5721:obj:4: BSpeak with the spirit of ⟦E3⟧ Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.
rows.quest:5721:details:0: Now, ⟦30⟧, you will take part in battle of Darrowshire, and you will save ⟦E3⟧ Redpath.
rows.quest:5721:details:1: BPlace this relic bundle in the Darrowshire town square, and the spirits of Darrowshire will rise. Join their battle and assure that these two things come to pass: Davil must survive beyond the death of Horgus, and Redpath must survive to be corrupted, then defeated.
rows.quest:5721:details:2: BAfter defeating the corrupted Redpath, his spirit will be saved. Speak with him, then return to his daughter Pamela.
rows.quest:5721:completion:0: The fighting is over! I heard my daddy whisper to me. He scared away all the ghosts and he says he's coming home! I'm so happy!
rows.quest:5721:completion:1: BHe also said I should welcome you if came to our house, so I made some tea!
rows.quest:5721:completion:2: BI hope you like lots of sugar!
rows.quest:5742:obj:0: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.
rows.quest:5742:details:0: You have worked hard, friend. Rest your weary bones and allow me to properly introduce myself.⟦31⟧
rows.quest:5742:completion:0: The Fordring redemption will be a difficult task. Are you prepared?
rows.quest:5781:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the ⟦E2⟧ - and recover Taelan's ⟦E17⟧. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
rows.quest:5781:details:0: To help Taelan regain what he has lost, you must gather items from his past.
rows.quest:5781:details:1: BThe first such item is a toy that I gave to him on his 7th birthday. It was his most cherished possession: A miniature war hammer; an exact replica of my very own.
rows.quest:5781:details:2: BAfter I was banished for treason, his mother told him that I had died. He was taken to my false grave at the Undercroft, where he buried the hammer along with my memory - forever.
rows.quest:5781:details:3: BYou must venture to the Undercroft and recover Taelan's hammer.
rows.quest:5781:completion:1: BIt was destiny that we meet, ⟦32⟧. You have blessed me with your kindness.
rows.quest:5845:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the ⟦E2⟧, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
rows.quest:5845:details:0: The Order of the Silver Hand was utterly decimated when Uther was slain.
rows.quest:5845:details:1: BThe boy held out for as long as he could. Pushed to the war torn hamlet of Northdale, he made his final stand.
rows.quest:5845:details:2: BWere any of the Order left alive, he thought - and did it matter?
rows.quest:5845:details:3: BIt was with that thought that Taelan threw down the standard of the Order and renounced all that he had known. His honor left upon the blood soaked ground of Northdale.
rows.quest:5845:details:4: BYou must travel to Northdale and recover that symbol of lost honor.
rows.quest:5845:completion:0: It is as glorious now - even in its tattered state - as the day I looked upon it and took my oath of allegiance.
rows.quest:5845:completion:1: BHis redemption comes and perhaps mine with it...
rows.quest:5846:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to island of ⟦E18⟧, in the south-central region of the ⟦E8⟧, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.
rows.quest:5846:details:0: When Taelan was a child, we would oft visit ⟦E18⟧ on family excursions. On our last visit, an artist by the name of Renfray painted a portrait of us poised along the beachside. It is my fondest memory of both Taelan and Karandra. For it was at that moment, with my wife and son in my arms, that I felt a bond of love and family that I would never know again.
rows.quest:5846:details:1: BIf this painting still exists, you must find it.
rows.quest:5846:details:2: BTravel to the ruined island of ⟦E18⟧ and see if the painting or the artist remain.
rows.quest:5846:completion:0: How could I forget? Many of the spirits on this island are cursed to relive their last happy memory before they met their tragic end.
rows.quest:5846:completion:1: BI too am cursed, but not as they - I am one of the few that remembers all...
rows.quest:5846:completion:2: BPerhaps this thing that you ask me is why I haunt these ruins. Perhaps this thing I tell you shall set me free.
rows.quest:5941:obj:0: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
rows.quest:5941:details:0: You have gathered many relics of the battle of Darrowshire. Each time you returned with more, my heart yearned for my village... yearned to protect it from its fate.
rows.quest:5941:details:1: BI know that cannot be, but Chromie, that strange gnome in Andorhal, tells me it is possible. She says you can save Darrowshire!
rows.quest:5941:details:2: BShe asked me to gather together the relics, and to have you bring them to her. She said that she awaits you in the ruined inn of Andorhal.
rows.quest:5941:completion:0: Ah yes, there they are. Together they weave a powerful spell, one that will raise the spirits of Darrowshire.
rows.quest:5941:completion:1: BWith that spell, and with a little luck, we can save ⟦E3⟧ Redpath!
rows.quest:5942:details:0: Daddy told me to give you this key. He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.
rows.quest:5942:details:1: BHe also wanted me to thank you. Did you do a favor for him? Did you tell him you found my doll?
rows.quest:5942:details:2: BWell here's the key. And thank you ⟦33⟧. Thank you! You're a very nice ⟦34⟧!
rows.quest:5942:completion:0: The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...
rows.quest:6021:obj:0: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's ⟦E6⟧ Chapel.
rows.quest:6021:details:0: Can you believe that, after all the trouble we have in the plaguelands... we have to worry about thieves too? And not just normal thieves, troll thieves.
rows.quest:6021:details:1: BAnd not just normal troll thieves. Dead troll thieves!
rows.quest:6021:details:2: BThey're led by this big, dead troll named Zaeldarr the Outcast, and they come here at night and steal bodies from the pit below, then take them back to their evil, dead troll hideout--the Undercroft to the west.
rows.quest:6021:details:3: BGo there and take out Zaeldarr, ⟦35⟧. I'm sick to death of his mischief!
rows.quest:6021:completion:0: Great, you got him! And I hope you taught his gang a lesson too!
rows.quest:6022:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
rows.quest:6022:details:0: You kill with purpose while you remain on my stead.
rows.quest:6022:details:1: BYour first task is to feed my hounds.
rows.quest:6022:details:2: BTake this mortar and pestle and travel to Corin's Crossing. Once there, you will find a robust selection of Scourge to slaughter. From their fresh carcasses I need living rot. Take that living rot and grind it up in the mortar, then let it sit to coagulate. Bring the coagulated rot back here.
rows.quest:6022:details:3: BAnd imbecile, realize that living rot from the undead doesn't remain 'living' for very long. You must kill quickly!
rows.quest:6022:completion:0: Disappointing. I was hoping that I'd be feeding you to my hounds, instead.
rows.quest:6022:completion:2: BWell, at least you they'll have something to eat.
rows.quest:6024:obj:0: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
rows.quest:6024:details:0: Kill me. Before it's too late.
rows.quest:6024:details:1: BI am Hameya. While traveling to Zul'Mashar, my brethren and I ate some bad meat... and we changed. We are infected.
rows.quest:6024:details:2: BI can feel the lich's words now, urging me to reach Zul'Mashar and infect more of my people. I cannot resist, and so I wrote this scroll before my will left me.
rows.quest:6024:details:3: BI buried a chest in dirt next to a wagon behind this crypt, but only my key will open it. I have the key. If you want my treasure, then find me.
rows.quest:6024:details:4: BKill me. Before it's too late.
rows.quest:6026:obj:0: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
rows.quest:6026:obj:1: BYou will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.
rows.quest:6026:details:0: These here Argent Dawn people commissioned ol' Smokey to do a little demolition work for 'em. Smokey's mammy ain't raised no dummy. When gold coin is slapped on the table, Smokey's services are available. That's my motto!
rows.quest:6026:details:1: BNow I'd be willing to split the commission with you if you're willing to do a little legwork. Here's the deal: I'm going to head over to Plaguewood and mark the buildings we need destroyed. You gather the components for the bombs. Meet back here when you've got everything. Deal?
rows.quest:6026:completion:0: I can pay you half up front and half when the job is done.
rows.quest:6041:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's ⟦E6⟧. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
rows.quest:6041:obj:1: BOnce you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.
rows.quest:6041:obj:2: BBy the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.
rows.quest:6041:details:0: While you were gathering the supplies, I had some of my people handle marking the Scourge buildings we need demolished.
rows.quest:6041:details:1: BHere's the plan: I'm going to give you ten sticks of my special compound. You're going to take them over to Plaguewood and plant them inside the Scourge structures that I've had marked for detonation.
rows.quest:6041:completion:0: You're much darker than I remember. You got that look going for you; the look that says, 'I've been charred by a high explosive bomb.'
rows.quest:6041:completion:2: BAnyhow! Here's your cut of the loot. I've thrown in a little something extra to help soothe the burns.
rows.quest:6042:obj:0: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to ⟦E19⟧ Blightcaller when you are finished.
rows.quest:6042:details:0: You cannot take two steps off of this farm without running into one of those obnoxious bats. I want to be able to take the hounds out and slaughter Scourge without being accosted by any damned, dirty bats. Obviously, I have better things to do with my time than mindlessly kill bats day in and day out. You, however, do not.
rows.quest:6042:details:1: BWhat? Your training? This is your training! Now get out of my sight and don't come back until you've killed a fair number of those winged demons. Don't disappoint me.
rows.quest:6042:completion:0: It's incredible what a little anger and rage can get accomplished.
rows.quest:6133:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to the northern borders of the ⟦E2⟧ and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
rows.quest:6133:obj:1: BYou must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.
rows.quest:6133:details:0: The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, ⟦39⟧: A document detailing my life as a mortal.
rows.quest:6133:details:1: BBefore you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry.
rows.quest:6133:details:2: BAnd imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. Leave them suffering...
rows.quest:6133:completion:0: I trust you did not read the registry. Not even you would do something that idiotic...
rows.quest:6135:obj:0: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to ⟦E19⟧ Blightcaller.
rows.quest:6135:obj:1: BIt is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
rows.quest:6135:details:0: Up until now, you have completed the missions I have assigned; even if not in the most timely manner.
rows.quest:6135:details:1: BI suppose you think that you are ready for a challenge. Yes... Yes, imbecile, perhaps you are ready for a more involved set of missions.
rows.quest:6135:details:2: BThe albino demon bat, Duskwing, roams the countryside just north of here. Track him down and destroy him. Return to me with a patch of his white fur and you shall be rewarded.⟦40⟧
rows.quest:6135:completion:0: Excellent work, imbecile. I shall fashion this fur into something you can use.
